findings.text: test named test_the_obligation_remedy_line_runs_as_printed appends --wait to the obligation's printed line, so the line is no longer run as printed and a regression that leaves the printed line unable to carry out a promotion in the call cannot redden it; the append is otherwise sound because reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3532-3537 makes the CLI default file a durable request and --wait carry it out.
